messages:
eng-oncall-bot: Nightwatch alert: nightly-ci/bench-smallbatch shard-7 p95 up 12% vs baseline (07:02 UTC). Details: <https://dash.redwood.ai/bench/3668> :rotating_light:

alice.k: saw the alert, grabbing logs. any specific commit pinned?

ryan: looks like it started at ~07:00 on shard-7. failing test: smallbatch_tail_latency_v2. could be KV cache thrash or an epoll regression.

alice.k: running reproduce locally, command: ./scripts/nightwatch_run --suite=smallbatch --shard=7 --trace

liam_p: @alice.k ping me if you need flamegraphs, perf VM is free right now. :thumbsup:

maria: quick Q — did we flip any kernel scheduler flags in last rollout? i vaguely remember a sched_monotonic tweak.

jake: not to prod pools, only a canary. i'll check canary rollout history and diffs.

ryan: stacktrace points to epoll_wait spikes, and more syscalls. might be a change in the IO batching path in recent runtime patch.

alice.k: repro started, attaching sample run:
```
rt_bench --mode=nightly --sample=42 --output=out.json
p95: 120ms -> 135ms
conf: 95%
```

liam_p: can you upload out.json to s3 so i can run flamegraph? path: s3://redwood-nightwatch/nightly/3668412345/out.json

alice.k: uploaded the sample. link above.

liam_p: grabbing it now, running perf record / flamegraph. give me ~10m.

ryan: in the meantime can we rollback the kernel tweak on the canary pool? @jake any objections to a quick rollback?

jake: rolling back canary patch in 2m, will post status.

eng-oncall-bot: Rollback started by jake at 07:18 UTC — target pool: canary-rt-1

liam_p: flamegraph shows a hot path in `kvcache::evict_if_needed` with heavy lock contention around shard 3.

alice.k: confirmed locally: enabling sharded eviction reduced p95 from 135ms -> 118ms. i can try a small patch to make eviction per-shard by default.

maria: if that patch holds up in canary we should promote and run full nightly. sounds promising.

alice.k: patch submitted: https://phabricator.redwood.ai/D12345 — includes per-shard eviction and a metric for lock_wait_ms.

ryan: kicking off a focused nightwatch run on canary after rollback + patch.

jake: rollback completed, canary back to previous runtime. monitoring dash.

eng-oncall-bot: Nightwatch check-in: canary p95 returned to baseline after rollback + temporary patch. continuing to monitor for 30m.

alice.k: thanks everyone — will follow up with a short postmortem and the perf numbers in #postmortems if anything else crops up.
